anya: Quick sync: I prototyped a tiny "runway controller" to coordinate safe API migrations. Controller publishes signed rule bundles; edges subscribe and apply per-tenant rules (rewrite, sampling, phase). Short-lived windows, TTLs, and auto-rollback. thoughts?

raf: Nice. Metric gating is essential. Add runway.requests/errors/latency_p95 tagged by tenant/rule/phase. Only promote phases when thresholds pass.

mira: Streaming endpoints are trickywe should flag those in rules and force passthrough or a binary tunnel. Also require owner and expiry in every bundle.

samir: For Dedicated/private: central signs bundles, operators can pull signed bundles locally. Also add `X-Runway-Negotiate` header to negotiate streaming/upgrades and cache result per-client to reduce latency.

anya: Phase plan: observe -> monitor -> soft_rewrite (sample) -> opt_in -> force. Each phase has TTL and circuit that pauses on regressions.

raf: ops circuit: trip if errors > 0.5% for 5m or p95 delta > 10%. auto-pause and notify owner + on-call.

mira: Ops runbook stub: revert phase, collect signer bundle, escalate if rollback fails, and keep an audit trail.

samir: I'll hack an Envoy filter prototype for path transform + header injection.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runway-controller v0.1 deployed to infra-staging 1 smoke tests green :)
